info.title: Capital Franchise Supply Chain Management System API Document

get.description: Retrieve current user's shopping cart.
Retrieve a list of orders placed by the current logged-in customer.
Retrieve the payment history for the currently logged-in customer.
Retrieve a paginated list of refund tickets created by the currently logged-in user.

post.description: Customer proactively creates a refund request (ticket) for a specific transaction or order.

200.description: {"message": "Tạo yêu cầu hoàn tiền thành công"}

get.description: Retrieve the wallet information and current balance of the logged-in user.

post.description: Generate a VNPay payment link to allow the user to deposit funds into their personal wallet.

500.description: Internal Server Error or Payment Gateway connection issue

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of wallet transactions (top-ups, deductions, refunds, etc.) for the currently logged-in user.
Retrieve the paginated withdrawal history for the currently logged-in user.

post.description:
Customer creates a request to withdraw funds from their wallet to a bank account. The requested amount is temporarily deducted immediately.
Use the API https://api.vietqr.io/v2/banks to fetch bank codes and names for the customer to select.
Provide a manual input field for the bank name in case the API fails or the bank is not listed.
If the customer enters the bank name manually, the bank code is not required.

patch.description: User cancels their own withdrawal request before it is processed by an Admin (PENDING status). Funds are refunded back to the wallet.

200.description: {"message": "Đã hủy yêu cầu rút tiền thành công và hoàn tiền vào ví."}

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all orders with optional filtering parameters (Admin/Manager view).

post.description: Create a new order based on the provided items, store, and shipping information.

get.description: Retrieve the payment history of the entire system (Intended for Administrators and Accountants).
Get a detailed revenue breakdown by product and category, primarily used for rendering dashboard charts.
Download the revenue report as a CSV file for bookkeeping and offline analysis.

Retrieve sales trend data (revenue, order volume) grouped by a specific time aggregation (hour/day/week).
**AUTHORIZATION NOTE (StoreId):**
- **Admin:** Can provide a `storeId` to view a specific store, or leave it blank to view system-wide data.
- **Manager/Staff:** Even if a `storeId` is provided, the system will securely override it with the store ID associated with the logged-in user's token.

parameters.description: Mức độ gom nhóm dữ liệu. 0 = Hour, 1 = Day, 2 = Week.
parameters.name: aggregation

parameters.description: ID Danh mục sản phẩm (Tùy chọn)
parameters.name: categoryId

parameters.description: Thời gian bắt đầu. Bắt buộc nhập.
parameters.name: fromDate

parameters.description: Thời gian kết thúc. Bắt buộc nhập.
parameters.name: toDate

200.description: Trend data including peak/low time labels

get.description:
Download sales trend data (revenue, order volume) as a CSV file.
Supports the same filtering and storeId authorization logic as the JSON endpoint.

parameters.description: Mức độ gom nhóm dữ liệu. 0 = Hour, 1 = Day, 2 = Week.
parameters.name: aggregation

parameters.description: ID Danh mục sản phẩm (Tùy chọn)
parameters.name: categoryId

parameters.description: Thời gian bắt đầu. Bắt buộc nhập.
parameters.name: fromDate

parameters.description: Thời gian kết thúc. Bắt buộc nhập.
parameters.name: toDate

200.description: CSV File containing sales trend data

get.description: Get daily order counts and status breakdown, primarily used for rendering line charts on the dashboard.
Download daily order statistics as a CSV file.

200.description: CSV File containing order volume data

get.description: Endpoint for VNPay to redirect the browser after payment. Verifies the signature via gRPC and redirects to the Frontend UI.

parameters.description: Frontend URL path to redirect to after processing
parameters.name: redirectTo

302.description: Redirects to the Frontend application with payment status

get.description: Retrieve full details of a specific order by its ID, including items, store info, and delivery personnel.

put.description: Update the list of items in an existing order (typically allowed only when the order is in a 'Pending' state).

post.description: Manager assigns a specific staff member (delivery man) to handle an order's delivery.
A delivery staff member assigns themselves to handle an order's delivery. Staff ID is automatically extracted from the Token.
Generate a payment link (VNPay) for the specific order.

patch.description: Change the lifecycle status of an order (e.g., to 'Processing', 'Cancelled', 'Completed').

get.description: Retrieve a list of all refund tickets (Intended for Staff, Manager, Admin). Can optionally pass a `userId` in the query to filter by a specific user.
Retrieve detailed information of a specific refund ticket. The service layer handles authorization based on the user's role and token.

patch.description: Accept and process the refund request for the customer.
Cancel an active refund ticket (usually performed by the customer if they change their mind).
Confirm that the money transfer process is successful and close the refund ticket.

200.description: {"message": "Đã đánh dấu hoàn tất yêu cầu hoàn tiền"}

patch.description: Reject a refund request and provide a specific reason to the customer.

200.description: {"message": "Đã từ chối yêu cầu hoàn tiền"}

get.description: Intended for Staff, Manager, or Admin to retrieve a list of all wallet transactions. Can optionally pass a `userId` in the query to filter transactions for a specific user.
View details of a specific wallet transaction using its unique code (e.g., WT-12345).
View details of a specific wallet transaction using its UUID. The service layer verifies if the requesting user has permission to view this transaction.
Intended for Staff, Manager, or Admin to retrieve wallet information of a specific user by their User ID.

404.description: Wallet not found for this user

get.description: Callback endpoint for VNPay after a customer completes a wallet top-up payment. Validates the gRPC signature and redirects the user to the Frontend UI with the transaction status.

patch.description: Intended for Administrators to lock (suspend) or unlock a user's wallet.

200.description: {"message": "Cập nhật trạng thái ví thành công"}

400.description: Validation Error or Invalid Wallet UUID

get.description: Intended for administrators and accountants to view and filter the withdrawal requests of all users across the system.
Retrieve full details of a withdrawal request, including the raw bank account number and the processing history.

patch.description: Confirm that the request is valid and prepare for the fund transfer. The status changes to APPROVED.
Cancel a withdrawal request at any stage (Pending, Approved, Processing) UNLESS it is already completed or cancelled. The system automatically refunds the amount to the user's wallet.

200.description: {"message": "Admin đã hủy lệnh và hoàn tiền thành công."}

patch.description: Confirm that the bank transfer was successful. A receipt image (receiptFile) must be uploaded as proof.

200.description: {"message": "Đã hoàn tất yêu cầu rút tiền và cập nhật bằng chứng chuyển khoản."}

400.description: Missing required file or transaction ID

patch.description: Reject a PENDING withdrawal request. The system automatically refunds the deducted amount back to the user's wallet.

200.description: {"message": "Đã từ chối yêu cầu rút tiền và hoàn tiền vào ví."}
